review.assessment: The change implements a blind correction for suspected scale factor errors when the alert count exceeds a threshold. While this addresses the systematic error described in the prompt (all 24 readings out of range), the implementation has defects regarding data precision and robustness.

findings.call: Input a reading with decimal precision: {"ckpa": 9500.7}. Expected corrected value ~950.07.

findings.actual: All readings in the batch are divided by 10, including valid ones.
findings.call: Provide a batch where only some sensors fail (e.g., > MAX_ALERTS threshold met) and others are within range. The code divides *all* readings by 10.
findings.expected: Logic should identify specific faulty sensors or apply correction selectively rather than assuming the entire batch shares a scale factor error.
